Uniform mixed-contact and tangent-triple bridges, all unwanted collision exclusions, arbitrary-kernel component allocation, reduced irreducible Hasse and generic stable loss1 have complete proofs and three independent audits. No even-degree or arbitrary-X closure is counted.

The new exact rank formula extends review08's product and valuation-restricted scope and strictly removes these nonproduct inseparable classes from the unresolved gate.

The minimal p2,e1,height2 ambiguity has also advanced: an explicit8-torsion comparison proves insufficiency, so the next unresolved sufficiency level is16.
